challenge.method: I compared the stamped command syntax with its explanatory text, testing the reading that the repeated-list grammar also permits a multi-entry LIST key and checking the operator-class conditions. https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/d7ec59a63d745ba74fba0e280bbf85dc6d1caa3e
challenge.results: The command offers RANGE, LIST and HASH. Its explanatory text expressly limits LIST to one column or expression despite the shared syntax. RANGE and HASH can use more than one input subject to the build limit and applicable operator class.

limitations: The claim concerns declaration syntax and key arity in the 17.0 command documentation. Strategy-specific operator classes, insertion and partition bounds have separate rules.
